source: Architecture warning. Do not memorize one L1 size or one caching rule as “the ZXNAME0000XZ L1.” The durable idea is that a small on-chip hardware-managed structure can satisfy some requests before they consume L2 or ZXNAME0001XZ traffic. Exact capacity and behavior must be checked for the target architecture.
zh: 架构警告。不要将一种 L1 大小或一种缓存规则记忆为“ZXNAME0000XZ L1”。持久的想法是，小型片上硬件管理结构可以在消耗 L2 或 ZXNAME0001XZ 流量之前满足某些请求。必须检查目标架构的确切容量和行为。
